Aisha Khan: Hey payroll team — I was converted from contractor -> full-time effective 4/10. My 4/15 payrun shows FICA (SS/Medicare) taken on top of the contractor payment I got 4/5 (1099). Looks like I got double taxed. Can someone check?
Tom Reynolds: @Aisha can you confirm the 4/5 contractor payout amount and attach the invoice / 1099 stub you received? Also need your conversion HR record.
Aisha Khan: Contractor payout 4/5 was $4,200 (invoice #INV-334). I received it as contractor via payroll run PRN-5172 and got a 1099 stub. My hire date as FT in HR is 4/10 and offer letter shows salary start date 4/10. I attached both in DM.
Nora Chen: Quick tax note: when a worker is reclassified mid-period, we should not withhold FICA retroactively for contractor grosss already paid as 1099; we either issue refund or reclassify and file adjusted returns. We'll need docs to validate conversion date and payment classification.
PayrollBot: Payruns: PRN-5172 (2026-04-05) - contractor payout. PRN-5201 (2026-04-15) - FT payroll with FICA withheld. Automation rule: contractor payouts flagged as 1099 are excluded from employee FICA if conversion flag set before payrun. No conversion flag found for PRN-5172.
Tom Reynolds: Ok — steps: 1) Verify HR conversion record (done) 2) Check contractor payout classification (we have 1099 record) 3) If confirmed, create off-cycle refund for employee portion of FICA withheld on 4/15 and file adjustment with payroll tax team to correct reporting (W-2/1099 reconcile). This may trigger amended 941/1099 corrections.
Aisha Khan: I can confirm HR docs were submitted 4/7 but HR says conversion effective 4/10. 1099 was issued for 4/5 run before conversion. Happy to accept refund; please let me know if I need to file anything.
Nora Chen: We'll coordinate Tax Ops for any required amendments. If 1099 already issued for the 4/5 payrun, we'll need to reconcile W-2 vs 1099 totals. Recommend we refund the FICA portion net now and initiate tax filings to avoid A-133 exposure.
Tom Reynolds: Please DM the invoice + HR conversion doc if you haven't. I'll open a ticket for off-cycle FICA refund and tax reconciliation. ETA off-cycle payout 3-7 business days once docs verified.
PayrollBot: Ticket created: PRJ-PLY-10145 by Tom Reynolds  Off-cycle FICA refund + tax reconciliation pending docs.
Aisha Khan: Sent DM with invoice and HR offer + conversion email. Thanks!
Tom Reynolds: Got them. Kicking off adjustment and looping Tax Ops. Will update this thread with payment detail and any amends needed for 1099/W-2.
Nora Chen: Noted for Tax Ops: possible 941-X and corrected 1099/W-2 mapping. We'll advise on next steps after payroll posts the refund.
Aisha Khan: Appreciate the quick help. :pray:
